Unbalanced data is not conducive to the machine learning model's judgment of instability situations. A data augment method based on DeepSMOTE is proposed to generate high-quality unstable datasets. Then, an extreme learning machine (ELM) classifier is used to select the generated dataset with the highest G-mean value, which is used to fuse with the original dataset to construct a balanced dataset with a similar number of transient stability and instability samples. Finally, TSA is implemented based on the balanced dataset. It has been verified in the modified IEEE 39-bus system simulation example containing new energy that DeepSMOTE can effectively generate data that follows the distribution characteristics of the original data of power system, thereby improving the recognition rate of unstable samples in TSA. Moreover, it has strong robustness under wide area noise and effectively balances power system instability data.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Aging Mechanism and Methods for Improving Electrical Performance of PCBs in Substation Sensors
abstract: Printed circuit boards (PCBs) are usually the key areas of sensor failure in substations. Therefore, it is necessary to study the methods for improving the electrical performance of PCBs after thermal aging. Three typical interconnection structures of PCBs are extracted in this article. The mechanism that how the thermal aging affects the electrical performance of PCB interconnection structures is experimentally studied. Furthermore, the methods to improve the electrical performance of PCBs after thermal aging are proposed. The results indicate that thermal aging can gradually degrade the surface materials of PCBs, resulting in flocculent pits and material layering, reducing their insulation performance and causing a decrease in flashover voltage of about 20% to 25%. By optimizing the parameters of typical interconnection structures, the electrical performance of PCBs after thermal aging can be improved, and the maximum flashover voltage can be increased by about 40%.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Energy Scheduling for Grid-connected Multi-microgrid System Based on Colored Petri Net
abstract: With the promotion of distributed energy (DG) technologies, microgrid (MG) applications are becoming more and more widespread. To avoid unstable operations caused by the frequent interaction between an individual MG and the external grid, a grid-connected multi-microgrid (MMG) system energy scheduling should be investigated. In this paper, we establish a hierarchical model and scheduling strategy according to the architecture of the MMG system. Based on the Colored Petri nets, we build and simulate a hierarchical energy scheduling model using CPN IDE. Finally, the interacting power data before and after scheduling are obtained and compared, which shows that the model can reduce the interaction frequency between the sub-MG and the external grid, thus improving the stability of the MMG system.

articleTitle: Perspectives on Electric Vehicle Charging Station Planning in Distribution Networks: Promoter vs Network Operator
abstract: This paper provides a methodology for the planning of electric vehicle charging stations (EVCS) in distribution networks, taking into account both the promoter and the network operator perspective. The methodology take into account the actual network condition and planning scenarios relevant for the planning of EVCS. The methodology is described and applied to a use case based on the IEEE 33 bus system coupled with real datasets from the Portuguese distribution network, more specifically from a section of Lisbon's distribution network. A Nodal Load Allocation method is used in the siting process to progressively raise the load at each potential bus in order to reach the maximum allowable load, assessing the best location from the network operator perspective. Then, the Evolutionary Particle Swarm Optimization (EPSO) technique is used to dimension a potential Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) that might be necessary to allow a non-impactful connection of the EVCS in the grid. This paper presents and discuss the results of the implementation of this methodology and simulation results, comparing reinforcement investment from both the promoter and the network operator.

articleTitle: Preface
abstract: We were very delighted to introduce the conference proceedings of 2023 4th International Conference on Power Engineering (ICPE 2023), which had been held in Macau, China from December 11 13, 2023. The conference is sponsored by IEEE, Macau University of Science and Technology, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Science and Engineering Institute, and IEEE Macau Section. The conference has patrons including University of Quebec at Trois Rivieres, Haribin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), Politecnico di Milano, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Northeastern University, Faculty of Engineering, Mansoura University, University of Ferrara, Horus University Egypt, and others.
